episode_title: Thinking About a Cash Based Practice? Here's What I've Learned

real_qa.q: What pricing model does Dr Ashwari EMD use for its health coaching services?
real_qa.r: Dr Ashwari offers three pricing tiers: $169 per hour for any consultation, $399 per month for one live session monthly plus texting, and $1,200 per month for four weekly one-hour live sessions with priority texting and access to a Guava Health dashboard that integrates wearable data.
real_qa.requete: Dr Ashwari EMD pricing tiers health coaching

real_qa.q: Why did Dr Ashwari discontinue direct primary care offerings in his practice?
real_qa.r: Dr Ashwari abandoned direct primary care because despite offering very low prices, he received no traction, primarily because he had no physical location and the service was virtual only. He found that health coaching at $1,200 per month was more sustainable than carrying the medical and liability risk of primary care at $150 per month.
real_qa.requete: Dr Ashwari why exit direct primary care

real_qa.q: What is the core difference between health coaching and concierge medicine according to Dr Ashwari?
real_qa.r: Health coaching is tedious and time-consuming, requiring ongoing behavioral and lifestyle support similar to cognitive behavioral therapy, while concierge medicine focuses on technology-driven interventions like GLP, PCSK9 injections, and full-body MRIs that patients perceive as high-value services. The disconnect is that people desire outcomes but lack the conscientiousness necessary to make sacrifices required for health coaching to work.
real_qa.requete: health coaching vs concierge medicine business model

real_qa.q: What specific wearable data integration platform does Dr Ashwari use in his practice?
real_qa.r: Dr Ashwari uses Guava Health (G-U-A-V-A), a platform that pulls in all wearable data for his $1,200 monthly coaching clients. He noted that patients are very interested in wearable data tracking and that it makes recommendations more convincing despite physicians often not needing wearable data to understand patient status.

real_qa.q: What concierge medicine pricing did Dr Ashwari observe among his Persian business contacts?
real_qa.r: Dr Ashwari observed that wealthy clients pay $7,000 per year for urgent care with no wait time, $6,000 for specific injections, and $15,000 per year for concierge clinic memberships that deliver high-touch technology-driven care including medications, supplements, and imaging protocols.

guest.bio_context: Dr. Mo Ashwari is a Persian-American physician who transitioned from physician consulting and medical board investigations to running his own health coaching practice. He is a digital nomad who has built a team of eight people including marketing, branding, and growth strategy specialists. He previously offered direct primary care services but shifted his business model to focus exclusively on health coaching, offering three pricing tiers and integrating wearable data via technology platforms.
